title: רב חנין
author: Heilprin source tradition; Warsaw digital witness
attribution: Fresh project English, authored from the frozen Hebrew and revised through source-informed author and independent model review. Editorial-layer attribution in the Warsaw witness remains qualified.

paragraphs: Rav Chanin said to Rav Ashi: Gittin 85b. Some say Choni: Elu Terefot. “Rav Chanin reported in Rav Zeira’s name”—Meilah 17a. “R. Chanin said: R. Chanina said”—Berakhot 32b. “R. Chanin said: Rav said”—Nedarim 7b; Yoma, chapter 4, 41b; Sotah 10a. Ein Yaakov has “R. Yochanan said.” It requires investigation whether this is the earlier Rav Ashi, since Chanin spoke in Rav's name, who lived long before the later Rav Ashi; or whether one is Rav Chanin and the other Rabbi Chanin.
